name: Four Seasons Oahu at Ko Olina
positioning: Beachfront resort on Oahu's western coast at Ko Olina, beside the Ko Olina Lagoons
best_for: Guests who want a beachfront resort on Oahu's western coast
Families who want a Keiki Pool and a complimentary kids program
Adults who want an adults-only infinity pool

facts.text: The resort's address is 92-1001 Olani Street, Kapolei, Hawaii 96707.
The resort is 30 minutes by car from Honolulu International Airport.
The resort is edged to the south by four beach coves known as the Ko Olina Lagoons.
Naupaka Spa & Wellness Centre is 35,000 sq ft.
Mina's Fish House is an ocean-view seafood restaurant.
Noe is an Italian restaurant that celebrates classic Southern Italian cuisine through handmade pastas.
The resort features four pickleball courts.
Camp Kohola is a complimentary keiki program.

highlights.text: The resort has an adults-only infinity-edge pool.
Dr. Mai Tai's is a swim-up bar at the water's edge of the adults-only infinity pool.
The Penthouse Suite is a two-bedroom suite on the 17th floor with an expansive private terrace.
The Club Lounge is 2,192 square feet and is described as the largest in the Four Seasons global portfolio.
A traditional lei greeting awaits each guest upon arrival.

considerations.text: The resort is a 35-minute drive from the shopping districts of Waikiki and downtown Honolulu.
Overnight valet parking is USD 55 per night.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the exclusive positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
